description: This file defines a set of XML-based simple methods related to content permission handling within the Apache OFBiz framework. It contains a method 'createContentAndPurpose' that creates content records, checks permissions, and manages content purposes, expected to be invoked as part of content management operations.

methods.name: createContentAndPurpose
methods.description: Creates content and its purpose, checks permissions, and manages primary key fields within the framework.
